assumptions.choice: 12 months in-sample = 252 trading days, 1 month gap = 21 trading days, 6 months OOS trading = 126 trading days. Window shift step per cycle = 147 trading days (21 gap + 126 OOS).
assumptions.reason: Translates calendar month spans into exact daily bar counts for precise, deterministic execution traces.

assumptions.choice: Long entries require EMA(50) >= EMA(200); Short entries require EMA(50) <= EMA(200).
assumptions.reason: Implements the stated rule: skip shorts if EMA(50) < EMA(200) is violated (i.e., when EMA(50) > EMA(200)) and skip longs if EMA(50) < EMA(200).

assumptions.choice: Exit long when Close >= fixed theta; exit short when Close <= fixed theta.
assumptions.reason: Implements mean-reversion take-profit exit upon price returning to theta.

assumptions.choice: Position size is computed using account portfolio value divided by max(distance to m*sigma stop, 1.5*ATR(14)), floored to whole integer shares.
assumptions.reason: Strictly matches the formula: quantity = (1% of capital) / max(distance to stop, 1.5*ATR(14)).
